entry.title: Resolution 672 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County): FC-182: Recommended Adoption - 09/15/26
entry.content:
AUTHORIZES THE PAYMENT OF FUNDS OF LATER FISCAL YEARS TO ENTER INTO A MULTI-YEAR LEASE AGREEMENT FOR AN EXCAVATOR WITH A MULCHING UNIT TO BE USED BY THE DEPARTMENT OF PUBLIC WORKS

Authorizes the Mayor to enter into a five-year lease agreement with an approximate total annual cost of $80,000, to be used for roadside repair, debris removal, clearing flood channels, and digging trenches.
